# Native platform attribution

`native/driver/radv_ps5_platform_native.c` retains Mihawk's 2026 copyright and
MIT identifier. Its native ownership, completion-worker, journal and placement
companions are adapted from the MIT-marked PS5-AI-MOSS-Image native application.
`native/driver/source-provenance.json` records each original source SHA256 and
the exact preserved native base archive. The original native descriptor and
statistics ABI identifiers remain intact.

Changes are Qwen-owned exclusive logging, bounded evidence retention and removal
of the unrelated optional MOSS timestamp-query diagnostic. Mesa headers and the
public native SDK are referenced locally, not redistributed. Existing upstream
notices continue to apply. The standard MIT permission notice is available in
the repository's [LICENSE](../../LICENSE).

PS5LM and PS5CEMU-HAR were inspected as implementation references. Their GPL
patch code is not incorporated into these MIT source files. Links and the
integration decisions are recorded in
[the source review](../../docs/native-driver-examples-20261022.md).
